dates.notes: Adopted in Malabo on 27 June 2014 by the Twenty-third Ordinary Session of the AU Assembly. Entered into force on 8 June 2023 after the deposit of the fifteenth instrument of ratification. The official AU status list is dated 2 February 2026.

legal_nature.rationale: A continental treaty adopted by the African Union Assembly and opened for signature, creating binding obligations for States Parties after entry into force. It is not a recommendation or a political declaration.
